title: Evaluation Record
description: A record of measurements produced by evaluating a candidate against a workload, optionally paired against a baseline candidate.

baseline_candidate_id.description: The candidate this evaluation was paired-compared against, if any.

workload_id.description: Cites an exact external workload/scenario identifier, e.g. a benchmark corpus filename -- never a paraphrase.

metric.description: An open, illustrative metric name, e.g. 'wall_seconds', 'human_interrupts', 'cost' -- not a fixed enum.

evaluator_id.description: An opaque identifier for whatever produced this record; must not encode a vendor or model name.
